question: How does agent({stallMs}) bound a child that stops making progress?
answer: The option sets a per-attempt stall window; text or thinking progress restarts the window under min(stallMs*0.1,1000)ms throttling, a silent window aborts that attempt with a DOMException('stalled','AbortError'), and the child retries up to 5 times before failing with 'agent stalled on all 6 attempts (no progress for Nms each)'. Without a positive finite option the request path is unchanged.

stallMs.default: off in this runtime (source default depends on the unported stream watchdog)
stallMs.progress: provider text/thinking chunks restart the timer
stallMs.failure: agent stalled on all 6 attempts (no progress for <stallMs>ms each)

passthrough: absent or non-positive stallMs leaves the provider call unchanged
caller abort is forwarded and rethrown
non-stall provider errors are rethrown immediately

adaptations: the source retries a whole query; this runtime retries one model request and does not replay tool calls
the source pauses the timer for in-flight tools; this runtime has no such tracking and uses stream progress only
stalledReason, replyLost and user-retry variants are not ported
the source default is not ported because the stream-watchdog stack is absent
